subject: Request to rebucket pricing and resequence SOW deliverables
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmeworks.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@acmeworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to rebucket pricing and resequence SOW deliverables

Hi Tom / Sara —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per AcmeWorks' request, attached is a draft change order that does two things we discussed: (1) rebuckets the committed throughput fees into a quarterly billing cadence (from annual), and (2) resequences the SOW deliverables so implementation milestones align with your pilot window (split Deliverable 2 into 2a/2b).

Quick summary of asks from our side: 
- Could you confirm whether the rebucketed fees should be prorated for Q3 only or apply retroactively to the full year?
- Are you comfortable with the proposed acceptance criteria for Deliverable 2a (pilot acceptance) vs 2b (GA cutover)?
- Please flag any procurement/legal requirements we should fold into the redline (e.g., insurance limits, audit language).

I've cc'd Laura for implementation sequencing and Karthik for contracts support. I've also attached the Acme_Requested_SOW_v3.docx (your changes) and a working PDF of our proposed orderform redline.

Proposed next steps:
1) Sara / Tom: review the two bullets above and confirm proration scope by Wednesday 8/11
2) Karthik / Markus: provide legal redline on the order form by Friday 8/13
3) Quick call (30m) to align on billing mechanics once Karthik's redline is in — propose Thurs 8/12 10:00 PDT

Thanks — looking to keep momentum so the pilot kicks on schedule.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Acme_Requested_SOW_v3.docx (docx), redline_orderform_jonas_20260807.pdf (pdf)

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmeworks.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@acmeworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to rebucket pricing and resequence SOW deliverables

Jonas —

Appreciate the draft. A couple quick clarifications from procurement before we loop legal: 
- Proration: we expect the rebucket to apply only prospectively from the next invoicing quarter (so Q4 start if signed before end of Q3). Applying retroactively will need internal controller approval — can Redwood do an implementation credit instead of retro billing?
- Billing mechanics: will there be an offset seat/throughput adjustment if actual usage deviates in the pilot? We need clear overage language.
- SLA/credits: if we split Deliverable 2, please confirm whether SLA start date is tied to 2a acceptance or 2b GA. Our preference is SLA to begin at 2b GA, with a limited pilot SLA in 2a.

Also tagging Sara for legal: Sara — can you advise if AcmeWorks needs a specific warranty carveout or data residency guarantee tied to 2b?

Tom
Tom Alvarez | Procurement Manager
AcmeWorks
tom.alvarez@acmeworks.com | +1 (212) 555-0198

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to rebucket pricing and resequence SOW deliverables — Redwood redline

Sara / Tom —

Thanks for the quick context, Tom. I've reviewed the attached orderform and SOW and uploaded a focused redline (redline_orderform_jonas_20260807.pdf). High level notes for legal ops: 

- Proration/credits: proposal to offer a one-time implementation credit equal to the prorated difference for Q3 (if Redwood chooses to make AcmeWorks whole for the mid-year change). Language added at Section 3.2.
- SLA start date: we agree that GA (Deliverable 2b) is the correct SLA trigger. I've added fallback language for a limited pilot SLA in 2a (15-day remediation window, capped credits).
- Overage mechanics: recommend we avoid per-token overage language in the orderform; instead reference the usage policy and propose a monthly reconciliation. That reduces contract churn.
- Data residency / warranty: I noted an optional carveout clause at Section 7.4; Sara, if you require a binding residency guarantee we will need to verify region availability and potentially route to a Private deployment (longer lead time).

Two items for commercial: 
1) If Acme requests retroactive rebucketing (full-year), Redwood would need a sign-off from finance; in practice we prefer the implementation credit approach.
2) We should capture an implementation handoff matrix in the SOW (owner, acceptance checklist) — Laura can draft a 1-page implementation appendix.

Next steps I propose: 
- Sara: confirm legal must-haves by Tue 8/10 EOD so we can finalize redline.
- Tom: confirm procurement position on implementation credit vs retro billing.
- Jonas/Laura/Karthik: prep final orderform and DocuSign-ready SOW once Sara confirms.

I've also added two minor edits to indemnity carveouts and insurance minimums — flagged in the PDF.

— Markus
Markus Klein | Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redline_orderform_jonas_20260807.pdf (pdf)
